```python
    "attributes": {
        "verdict": "malicious"
    }
}

# Endpoint for submitting a vote on an IP

headers = {
    "x-apikey": API_KEY,
    "accept": "application/json",
    "content-type": "application/json"
}

print("Status Code:", response.status_code)
print("Response Body:", response.json())
```
